title: Derived-category hom equality for exact-functor cocycle transport
statement: The derived-category morphisms underlying the exact-functor resolution cocycle identity are equal after applying the supplied comparison map.

source.place: derived.tex lemma-morphisms-lift, Tag 013P; cohomology.tex remark-explain-arrow, Tag 01FB. The sections were fetched into scratchpad and read. Ext specialization uses Mathlib InjectiveResolution.extMk_hom and Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom.

proof.text: Extend e by zero using comparisonExtension. At nonnegative indices conjugate e by the extension component isomorphisms; at negative indices the source is zero. The chain condition follows from e.comm. At degree zero he implies the augmentation equality by from_single_hom_ext.

In the derived category cancel the image of the mapped augmentation, which is invertible because L is exact. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryFactors and the single-complex comparison identify the denominator with Q(e) followed by the inverse target augmentation.

Conjugate a to the integer complex and verify its closedness from ha and the transported cocycle closedness from hc. By from_single_hom_ext, termwise functoriality and the shift comparison identify the mapped numerator followed by the shifted comparison with the numerator of L(a) followed by e in degree q.

Expand extMk_hom, mapExactFunctor_hom, comp_hom and mk₀_hom. Use ShiftedHom naturality for mapDerivedCategoryFactors to combine the numerator and denominator, substitute the preceding equalities, and cancel the component isomorphisms. Natural-to-integer successor casts agree. This proves the hom equality including q=0.

lean.statement: theorem exactFunctor_resolution_cocycle_hom {C : Type u₁} {D : Type u₂} [Category.{v₁} C] [Category.{v₂} D] [Abelian C] [Abelian D] [HasExt.{w₁} C] [HasExt.{w₂} D] [HasDerivedCategory C] [HasDerivedCategory D] (L : C ⥤ D) [L.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits L] [PreservesFiniteColimits L] {A : C} {B : D} (f : L.obj A ⟶ B) (R : InjectiveResolution A) (I : InjectiveResolution B) (e : (L.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj R.cocomplex ⟶ I.cocomplex) (he : L.map (R.ι.f 0) ≫ e.f 0 = f ≫ I.ι.f 0) {P : C} (q : ℕ) (a : P ⟶ R.cocomplex.X q) (ha : a ≫ R.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0) (hc : (L.map a ≫ e.f q) ≫ I.cocomplex.d q (q + 1) = 0) : (((R.extMk a (q + 1) rfl ha).mapExactFunctor L).comp (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ f) (add_zero q)).hom = (I.extMk (L.map a ≫ e.f q) (q + 1) rfl hc).hom
